final_readiness.scope: One actual native run over one document and one command. Demonstrates the valid packet shape and returned coverage, not every native schema rejection path or effective settings loaded by every running client.

browser_verification.scope: Actual rendering and interaction of the generated local explorer; dashboard HTTP checks are separately transport-only.

transport_checks.scope: Independent read-only transport observations; not application E2E or proof of current data freshness.

accounting.scope: Latest native session cumulative counters must be counted once; multiple result events repeat overlapping values and include authoring and previous attempts. Per-workflow counters are a different overlapping scope. Root coordination, Codex reviewers and unrelated tasks are excluded. No causal savings or subscription bill is inferred.

limitations: Three optional capabilities retain their earlier partial acceptance; no new-host or physical-PC reboot qualification.
Application hosting evidence remains fixture-scoped; no paid hosting, public deployment, broker action or new account connection.
Native review model citation/count transcription errors are retained; the evidence gate was not relaxed to relabel them accepted.
Portable native roles omit host-specific MCP permissions; tests use stubbed model responses and stay distinct from native execution.

local_checks.scope: Fixture source-enum/count assertions inspect generated schemas; gate tests exercise local JavaScript. Neither replaces upstream structured-output validator negative tests.
